source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 277 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-277.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 277 was established by Ordinance No. 19711, passed by the Dallas City Council on October 7, 1987. Ordinance No. 19711 amended Ordinance Nos. 10962 and 19455, Chapters 51 and 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 19455; 19711; 25711)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-277.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 277 is established on property generally located along the northeast line of Office Parkway, northeast of the northeast line of Haskell Avenue. The size of PD 277 is approximately 3.149 acres. (Ord. Nos. 19711; 25711)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-277.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A. (Ord. 25711)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-277.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 277A). (Ord. Nos. 19711; 25711)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-277.105. LANDSCAPING.

Landscaping must be provided as shown on the development plan and in accordance with the Dallas Development Code. All plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition at all times. (Ord. Nos. 19711; 25711)

sections.title: Permitted Uses And Floor Area
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-277.106. PERMITTED USES AND FLOOR AREA.

(a) The only permitted uses on the Property and maximum floor area are as follows:

Permitted uses Maximum floor area

Office 9,756 square feet

Rehabilitation center 18,285 square feet

Warehouse 16,474 square feet

Industrial center 28,342 square feet

(b) For the purposes of this article, the industrial center is limited to light assembly, collating, packaging, and labeling of products. (Ord. Nos. 19711; 25711)

sections.title: Maximum Height
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-277.107. MAXIMUM HEIGHT.

Maximum permitted height for any structure on the Property is 50 feet. (Ord. Nos. 19711; 25711)

sections.title: Setbacks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-277.108. SETBACKS.

Minimum setbacks for structures on the Property must be provided as shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 19711; 25711)

sections.title: Maximum Lot Coverage
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-277.109. MAXIMUM LOT COVERAGE.

Maximum lot coverage on the Property is 80 percent. The calculation of coverage includes above-grade parking structures. (Ord. Nos. 19711; 25711)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-277.110. OFF-STREET PARKING.

No fewer than 59 off-street parking spaces must be provided and located as shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 19711; 25711)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-277.111. SIGNS.

All signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Article VII. (Ord. Nos. 19711; 25711)

sections.title: Screening
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-277.112. SCREENING.

A six-foot-high living hedge must be provided and maintained along the northeasterly boundary of the Property. (Ord. Nos. 19711; 25711)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-277.113. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

Use of the Property must comply with the requirements of all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 19711; 25711)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-277.114. PAVING.

(a) All parking spaces, aisles, maneuvering areas, and driveway connections to streets or alleys, whether enclosed or unenclosed, must comply with the standards set forth in the Dallas Development Code.

(b) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 19711; 25711)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-277.115. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 19711; 25711)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-277.116. ZONING MAP.

PD 277 is located on Zoning Map No. I-7. (Ord. Nos. 19711; 25711)
